newsitem.title: FINLAND: LARGE IN-HOUSE DEAL IN ILKKA.
newsitem.headline: LARGE IN-HOUSE DEAL IN ILKKA.

text.p: Trade in Finnish newspaper and publishing house Ilkka Oy was boosted by a big in-house deal on Thursday afternoon.

A total of 139,700 Ilkka's more liquid II-series shares worth more than 21 million markka were traded at 155.00 markka per share, down 10.00, in-house by Opstock. Ilkka's II-series shares later rose to 164.00 markka.
On Wednesday, Ilkka II-series had set a new year-high 165.00 markka.
Opstock declined comment on the deal.
There was no one at Ilkka Oy available for comment.
Ilkka has two series' of shares, of which series I carries 20 votes per share and series II one vote per share.
By 1530/1330 GMT, Ilkka I-share was untraded.
